title: Karna Sarwar se Wafa
body:
Karna sarwar se wafa wada shikan kya jaane ...
Kyaa jaane
karna sarwar se wafa
wada shikan kya jaane
Bewafa jo
Hai wafa ka
Wo chalan kya jaane
....
Sunte hi zikre shahenshahe zaman kya jaane (2)
He padhi aap ke maathe wa shikan kya jaane ...
....
Hai udhar zulm yazeedi to idhar sabre hussain (2)
Isko rasata hai karbal ka wo ban kya jaane..
...
Dushmane aale nabi sunte hai jab naam-e-hussain (2)
Unke seeno me q hoti hai jalan kya jaane ...
....
Rok ne se naa rukegi ye azaaa-e-shabbir (2)
Ho chuke ishq ke liye kitne jatan kya  jaane ..
..
Rauze mehshar yahi bakshish ka sahara hogi (2)
Nukta chii sheh ki mohabbat ka wazan kya jaane..
....
Behte dariya pe lagaye we pehre sach hai (2)
Warna ye aap bagawat ka chalan kya jaane ...
...
Badle kangne ki kalai me dulhan qasim ki (2)
Aap batlai ye badwa naa rasam kya jaane ..
.. ...
Barchi hum shakle payember ki lagi thi lekin (2)
Kitne seeno me hui uski chuban kya jaane..
...
Hurmula kuwate baazu pa teri tu hi bata (2)
Muskuraane ke siwa guncha dahan kya jaane ...
...
Gusht amber se kare koi naa is nauhay se (2)
Ye ghulame shahedi sheh ro sukan kya jaane ...
